title: [Decision] Is "governed" a lane or an approval tier? The lane table gives `.github/workflows/**` to skills and to spec, while devx carries the AGENTS.md and workflow cards in practice
body:
Ruled: 6458715764 · letter B · 2026-10-28T02:08Z

Filing gate ②: a decision only the maintainer can make. The maintainer, in devx seat 2's session (`session_01QSeKYmTYfaPbLQD4BJfomW`), first asked, verbatim: 「AGENTS.md 不是应该归 skills 车道吗？」. Then, on the seat's answer: 「刚才的skills的问题立 决裁卡」. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 2 (#20163) · `os-justin`. ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ No `domain:*`: the fix lands in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, and triage sets the lane.
Business reason: the lane label decides who may claim a card and which files run serial. The lane table now gives one path family to two or three lanes, so the same card can be claimed by two seats, or by none.
Reader who acts: the director seat presents the card. After the ruling, the `domain:skills` seat edits the SKILL.md lane table (`.claude/**`, Tier S) and the triage seat relabels the open cards the letter moves.
Dedupe: titles of `domain:skills` and `tooling` issues (open and closed, 5 pages of each label) grepped for `lane table|domain table|车道表|governed.*(lane|domain)|AGENTS.md.*(lane|skills)|workflows.*(lane|domain)`. One hit: #19133 (closed). It narrowed the human-merge floor (Tier H vs Tier S), an approval axis, not lane ownership. **New.**

## 维护者速读

车道表（SKILL.md「域车道」）对同一批文件给了互相打架的归属：
- skills 行写「governed 面全量」归 skills，governed 面明确包括 `AGENTS.md`、`CLAUDE.md`、`.github/workflows/**`、`docs/NORTH-STAR.md`。
- devx 行又写 `.github/workflows`（接线）「按锚定规则归 domain:spec」。
- 实际上 devx 席一直在做这两类卡：AGENTS.md 三张（#26073、#26088、#26081），CI 工作流五张（#25452、#25870、#26586 第 2 项、#25914、#25913）。#25452 的工作流 PR 今天刚由 devx 落地。
你问「AGENTS.md 不是应该归 skills 吗」，按表面文字答案是「是」。但同一张表也让工作流归 skills 或 spec，与实践不符。

请裁：
- **A** governed 就是车道：凡 governed 路径（含工作流）都归 skills，devx 的 CI 卡全部移交。
- **B** governed 只是批准等级（Tier H/S），车道按主题分：规则文本（AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、`.claude/**`、`skills/**`、`docs/adr/**`、NORTH-STAR）归 skills；`.github/workflows/**` 的接线与 CI 性能归 devx，仍按 Tier H 人批。改表消除冲突。
- **C** 表不动，逐卡以分诊标签为准。

选 A / B / C？

## Governing text

- SKILL.md 「域车道」 `domain:skills` row (L162 at `origin/main`): "governed 面全量(含本文件;统一定义见「governed 面统一定义」行)".
- SKILL.md `domain:devx` row (L161): "`packages/lint`、`scripts`(门禁类)、`.github/workflows`(接线)三者按锚定规则归 `domain:spec`,门禁按 SUBJECT:governed 面归 skills".
- SKILL.md 〈路径分叉〉 (L183–184): "governed 面统一定义:`docs/adr/**`+`.claude/**`(全量)+`skills/**`+`docs/NORTH-STAR.md`+`.github/workflows/**`" · "governed 面同含 `AGENTS.md`+`CLAUDE.md`;… 执行席恒随落地仓车道".
- SKILL.md 「域车道」: "锚定规则:每个包恰属一个域;`domain:*` = 修复落地包的域".
- SKILL.md 「优先级」: "两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动并立卡;⛔ 不当场改文本了结". That rule is why this card exists instead of an edit.
- `references/lanes/devx.md` 「常设承诺」: "受管面 PR 照 SKILL.md 〈路径分叉〉的路径分叉执行". The devx job description itself expects devx to produce governed PRs.

## Premises (each with its re-check)

- P1, the conflict text. `git show origin/main:.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md | grep -n -E 'domain:devx\x60|domain:skills\x60|governed 面统一定义'` → L161, L162, L183. Positive control: the same grep shows `domain:spec`'s row at L163.
- P2, devx carries governed-path cards today (open cards this seat read today, fix paths from their claims and rulings):
  - `AGENTS.md`: #26073 (+ `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, mixed with `content/docs/**`; PR #26970 approved), #26088 remainder (L40/138/173 only), #26081 PR 1 (TOC + `docs/agents/`; its ruling 6417533492 already says "skills seat dispatches PR 1").
  - `.github/workflows/**`: #25452 (PR #26984, landed through devx with an approver's review), #25870 (`ci.yml` + `packages/cli` + `scripts/`), #26586 item 2 (`lint.yml` comment), #25914 (a new required job), #25913 (`ci.yml` wiring + `ui/scripts`).
  - Re-check: the cards' claim comments, `File surface:` lines.
- P3, the label origin. These cards were graded `domain:docs` (a retired lane, read as devx) or `domain:devx` at triage. The director's ruling records name devx in the workload column (#26073: "devx · 1 PR Tier H"). No seat applied the anchor rule to the governed paths. Re-check: the triage audit comments on #26073 (6415525262), #26081 (6415593935) and #26088 (6415687206).

## One-sentence problem

The rule that says who owns a file names two or three owners for the same workflow and instruction files, so a card's lane depends on which line of the table a seat happens to read.

## Options

| Option | What | Consequence | Workload |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Governed = lane. Every governed path (incl. `.github/workflows/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`) is `domain:skills`. Mixed cards split by lane, or triage designates one lane (the existing cross-domain path). Drop the devx row's workflows clause. | One owner per path. The skills lane takes all CI workflow work; today that is 5 cards from devx plus the 3 AGENTS.md cards, and devx keeps docs/QA. CI performance work moves to the seat that writes rule text. | skills · 1 PR (SKILL.md table, Tier S) + triage relabels ~8 open cards · precedent: none read |
| B | Governed = approval tier, lane by subject. Rule text (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`) is `domain:skills`. `.github/workflows/**` wiring and CI performance is `domain:devx`, still Tier H (approver review). Gates stay by SUBJECT as today. Rewrite the skills row from "governed 面全量" to the rule-text list, and the devx row's workflows clause to "归本域". | One owner per path, matching what seats do today. The AGENTS.md cards go to skills (#26088 and #26081 are already marked `pm:retriage`). The workflow cards stay in devx. Approval stays exactly as strict, because Tier H is a property of the path, not of the lane. | skills · 1 PR (SKILL.md table, Tier S) + triage relabels 2 cards (#26088, #26081) |
| C | No change. The triage label decides per card; any lane may land a governed edit under Tier H. | The contradiction stays. The next triage pass can label the same kind of card differently, and two seats can claim one file. | 0 |

## Business meaning

- A: every governed file has one locksmith, and the locksmith also does the plumbing.
- B: the locksmith keeps the rulebook, and the plumber fixes the pipes; the building inspector (Tier H approval) signs off on both.
- C: whoever reaches the door first.

## 四维分析

- **实际业务需求**：实测 devx 今天在做 8 张 governed 路径的卡（P2），其中 5 张是 CI 工作流，3 张是 AGENTS.md。工作流卡的内容是 CI 速度、缓存、分片，与 devx 的开发者体验职责一致；AGENTS.md 是规则文本，与 skills 的职责一致。A 会把 5 张 CI 卡推给写规则的座位，C 让每次分诊各凭理解。
- **项目长远合理性**：车道（谁做、谁串行）和批准等级（谁签字）是两根独立的轴。B 把两轴分开：Tier H/S 仍按路径强制，车道按主题，冲突一次消除。A 把两轴绑死，CI 工作会挤进 skills 席。C 留着矛盾，等下一次误标。
- **防 AI 犯错**：分诊和执行席都靠这张表机械地定车道。一条路径只对应一个车道，表才能被机械读对。B、A 都做到了，C 做不到，今天的误派就是 C 的现状造成的。批准不放松：B 下工作流 PR 仍要人批。
- **创业阶段不扩散**：三者都不加门禁、不加文件。B、A 只改车道表几行。

## Recommendation

**B.** Read on ① alone: B. Do ②③④ flip it? No. In two years the fleet should have two independent axes: a lane per path by subject (who works and serializes) and an approval tier per path (who signs). The mainstream analogue is CODEOWNERS versus branch protection: one says who maintains a path, the other says what a merge needs. B gives each path exactly one lane without loosening any approval. A would also give one lane per path, but it routes CI performance work to the rule-text seat.

Confidence gaps: whether `scripts/` gate files under the devx row's "门禁类 → spec" clause also need restating under B. They are out of this card's question; the table PR names it if the wording touches them. The count of affected cards is from this seat's reads today, not a full-board scan.

## After the ruling

- B: the skills seat opens one `.claude/**` PR (Tier S, with a contract review) rewriting the skills and devx rows. Triage relabels #26088 and #26081 to `domain:skills` (already marked `pm:retriage`). #26073's PR #26970 lands as the declared cross-lane exception (cross-seat note on the card).
- A: the same PR with the other wording; triage relabels the 8 cards in P2 and splits the mixed ones (#26073, #25870, #25913).
- C: no PR; this card closes with the ruling recorded, and the contradiction is accepted.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性：B 把车道（按主题）与批准等级（按路径）分成两根轴，一次消除表内三处冲突，不放松批准。
② 实际业务拉动：devx 今天在做 8 张 governed 路径卡，5 张 CI 工作流、3 张 AGENTS.md；今天已因此误派一次。
③ 防 AI 犯错：一条路径一个车道，分诊才能机械读表；C 保留今天误派的根因。
④ 创业阶段不扩散：零新门禁零新文件，只改车道表几行。
Prior rulings read: governed, lane, domain table, AGENTS.md skills → 1 hit; #19133 (closed: Tier H/S floor, approval axis only); ADR none; thread: devx seat 2 session (maintainer's question, quoted above)
